description:

* **fizz:** added support for Fizz 1.72.0 via per-version bytecode targets ([27b0b51](https://github.com/ihatenodejs/aidans-patches/commit/27b0b514f4b65949cacd73efd19d7a1b83bab2e6))

patches.name: Remove Ads and Tracking
patches.description: Disables Adobe MobileCore, EventHub, Document Cloud Analytics (DCMAnalytics and ARDCMAnalytics), Adobe Growth Platform (DGP/MAU), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Branch deep-link attribution, Creative SDK, Next Best Action (NBA) tools profiling, Facebook App Events, Firebase Performance, Firebase Sessions, and Crashlytics telemetry; suppresses Google Mobile Ads (AdMob), interstitials, rewarded ads, banner pools, paywalls, and in-app reviews; removes telemetry preferences; and zeroes the Google Play Advertising ID.

options.description: Disables Adobe MobileCore, EventHub, Document Cloud Analytics (DCMAnalytics and ARDCMAnalytics), Adobe Growth Platform (DGP/MAU), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Branch attribution, Creative SDK, Next Best Action (NBA) tools profiling, Facebook App Events, Firebase Performance, Firebase Sessions, Crashlytics, and zeroes the Google Play Advertising ID.

Disables in-app ads (AdMob banners, native ads, document-close interstitials, rewarded edit interstitials, and prefetching), ad performance metrics, ad analytics, dynamic paywalls, and in-app review prompts.
Removes the Send usage info and Send crash reports preferences from the Preferences menu, and suppresses crash reporting dialogs.

apps.app_name: Adobe Scan AI PDF Scanner, OCR

patches.name: Local Premium
patches.description: Enables locally executable premium OCR, editing, compression, and password protection tools without cloud or GenAI access.

options.description: Replaces Adobe Document Cloud post-save compression with on-device JPEG stream re-compression. Overrides Compress PDF removal when enabled.
Replaces Adobe Document Cloud password encryption with AES-256 on-device PDF protection and offline removal.
Replaces Adobe Document Cloud export with on-device editable Word, Excel, and PowerPoint conversion. Layout reconstruction is best-effort.
Combines local Adobe Scan documents into a new PDF on device without changing the originals.

patches.name: Remove Ads and Tracking
patches.description: Disables Adobe Experience Platform MobileCore, EventHub, Adobe Growth SDK (DGP/MAU and Dunamis), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Creative SDK, Branch attribution, Facebook App Events and Audience Network, Firebase Performance, Firebase Sessions, and Crashlytics telemetry; suppresses Google Mobile Ads (AdMob), interstitials, banner preloaders, and in-app reviews; removes telemetry preferences; zeroes the Google Play Advertising ID; and blocks hardware android_id collection.

options.description: Disables banner and interstitial ads, banner preloading, ad analytics, and InMobi SDK initialization.
Disables Adobe Experience Platform MobileCore, EventHub dispatch, Adobe Growth SDK (DGP/MAU and Dunamis), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Creative SDK, and AEP NetworkService.
Disables Firebase Performance Monitoring (AppStartTrace and network timing), Firebase Sessions, Firebase Installations, and Crashlytics collection.
Disables Facebook SDK initialization (FacebookInitProvider), Audience Network ContentProvider, App Events logging, and remote settings fetch.
Zeroes the Google Play Advertising ID, blocks Install Referrer, and neutralizes hardware android_id collection in AccountManager and Creative SDK.
Suppresses in-app rating and review dialogs.
Removes the Send usage info and Send crash info preferences and suppresses the crash reports dialog, whose telemetry backends are disabled by this patch.

patches.name: Remove Attribution
patches.description: Names new scans 'Scan on [date]' instead of 'Adobe Scan [date]' and removes the attribution text from shared files.

options.description: Names new scans 'Scan on [date]' instead of 'Adobe Scan [date]'.
Removes the promotional 'Created and shared using Adobe Scan.' text from shared files.

patches.name: Remove Login
patches.description: Starts Adobe Scan in its existing account-free local workspace and removes account sign-in gates; Adobe cloud features are unavailable.

options.description: Removes the profile icon, sign-out, and sign-in options from the Settings menu.
Removes cloud link sharing options from the Share sheet, preserving local PDF sharing.
Removes the non-functional Edit text option from file option menus and the preview screen.
Removes the non-functional Move file option from file option menus.
Removes the cloud-dependent Save as Word doc option from scan cards.

patches.name: Remove Useless/Promotional Items
patches.description: Removes promotional, feedback, and broken cloud items from Settings and file menus.

options.description: Removes the About Adobe Scan item from the Settings menu.
Removes the Help item from the Settings menu.
Removes the Rate app item from the Settings menu.
Removes the Online support forum item from the Settings menu.
Removes the Share this app item from the Settings menu.
Removes the Fill & Sign item from file option menus and Recent scan cards.
Removes the Open in Adobe Acrobat option from file option menus, the preview screen, and Recent scan cards.
Removes Generative summary actions from the File Options bottom sheet.
Removes Edit text from file option menus, the preview bottom toolbar, and scan cards.
Removes Move file from file option menus across all surfaces.
Removes Compress PDF from file option menus and Send compressed from the Share sheet. Automatically skipped if Local PDF Compression is enabled.

patches.name: Use System Font
patches.description: Overrides Adobe Clean fonts across XML layouts, dialogs, and Jetpack Compose screens with the device's system font.

patches.description: Adds an option to copy tracking numbers in the multi-shipment selection menu.

patches.name: Bypass Native Signature Check
patches.description: Neutralizes APK signature verification in libandroidsig-lib.so so API requests succeed when signed with custom keys.

patches.name: Custom Google Maps API Key
patches.description: Replaces the embedded Google Maps API key with a personal Google Cloud API key so native Google Maps renders on re-signed builds. Note: To use native Google Maps, disable the OpenStreetMap Drop-in Replacement patch.

options.description: Custom Google Maps API key from Google Cloud Console (with Maps SDK for Android enabled).

patches.name: Full AMOLED Theme
patches.description: Themes AfterShip in pure AMOLED black by removing dark gray backgrounds from the bottom navigation bar, account items, cards, and windows.

patches.name: Hide Broken Tracking Map
patches.description: Suppresses the unauthenticated blank white Google Maps view when neither a custom Google Maps API key nor OpenStreetMap is used.

patches.description: Replaces the broken Google Maps view with a free, self-contained OpenStreetMap (Leaflet) engine that renders routes, checkpoints, and dark/light styled tiles without requiring an API key.

options.description: Displays floating + and − zoom buttons on the map.

patches.name: Remove Ads and Tracking
patches.description: Neutralizes in-app advertisements (Disco Network SDK shopping/cashback ads and list placements), removes the 'Leave us a 5-star review' in-app rating prompt dialogs, zeros the Google Play Advertising ID (AAID), disables first-party behavioral and impression analytics (StatisticsCenter, AbsListImpEventHelper, AutoUploadManager), and blocks diagnostic telemetry (Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Logan logging).

patches.name: Remove AfterShip Account Page Links
patches.description: Removes the About the app, Share the app, and Feedback links from the Account screen.

patches.name: Remove Feedback
patches.description: Removes prompting for feedback on shipments.

patches.description: Forces guest mode always on first install, removes login buttons and carousels, strips account/login controls from the Account tab, and suppresses login prompts.

patches.name: Remove Shipment Sync
patches.description: Removes email shipment synchronization features, including prompts, banners, dialogs, empty state sync cards, and account settings.

Neutralizes Sentry crash reporting, performance tracing, and operational session telemetry.

patches.name: Display Cutout Adaptation

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes in-app promotional message campaigns and popups (OneSignal In-App Messages), neutralizes in-app review and rating prompts, and zeroes Google Play and Huawei Advertising IDs.

Neutralizes Google Play in-app review and rating prompts.

Neutralizes Firebase Crashlytics crash reporting and diagnostic logging.
Neutralizes Instana End-User Monitoring (EUM) and background telemetry workers.
Neutralizes Branch Metrics attribution and event tracking.
Blocks OneSignal custom events, session outcomes, tags, and location tracking.

Initializes application state with Demo Mode enabled upon startup.

patches.name: Remove Tracking
patches.description: Neutralizes Google Play Advertising ID tracking, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Datadog telemetry, Kochava attribution, New Relic, Segment, Qualtrics, root/emulator checks, and integrity attestation.

Blocks Firebase Analytics and Google Play AppMeasurement event and property logging.
Neutralizes Firebase Crashlytics crash reporting and diagnostic logging.

Neutralizes Intuit Scribe telemetry and diagnostic log upload tasks.

patches.description: Unlocks geocache log templates, allowing creating, editing, and applying custom log templates without Geocaching Premium.

patches.name: Change App Icon
patches.description: Recolors the Canvas launcher icon and optionally replaces its foreground with a custom PNG. The colors also theme the launch splash screen and the signed-out Canvas logo when changed. The image is an adaptive-icon foreground, so launchers mask it to their icon shape; keep artwork inside the central safe area of a 432x432 PNG.

options.description: Color of the original launcher foreground vector (#RRGGBB or opaque #AARRGGBB). Also tints the monochrome icon vector and, when changed from the default, the splash logo, animated loader, and signed-out Canvas logo.
Adaptive icon background color (#RRGGBB or opaque #AARRGGBB).
Splash screen background color used when Theme Splash Screen is enabled (#RRGGBB or opaque #AARRGGBB). Independent of the launcher icon background.
Applies the splash background color to the Android 12+ system splash and the legacy splash window, and the foreground color to the splash logo and animated loader, when each differs from its default.
Tints the Canvas mark on the signed-out landing page with the foreground color when it differs from the default.
Optional square PNG used as the adaptive icon foreground. The launcher masks the image to its icon shape, so keep artwork inside the central safe area.

patches.name: Change App Name
patches.description: Replaces the launcher label shown under the app icon. In-app text is unchanged.

options.description: Launcher label shown under the app icon.

patches.name: Clone App
patches.description: Changes the package name so this build installs alongside the original Canvas Student. The clone has separate app data. Re-signed or cloned App Links, push notifications, and package/certificate-bound services may not work; verify login, sharing, and document viewing.

options.description: Android package name for the clone. It must contain at least two segments and must differ from com.instructure.candroid.

patches.name: Disable AI Study Tools
patches.description: Hides Study Tools and stops page content from being sent to Instructure's AI study-assist endpoint.

patches.name: Fix PDF Viewer Crash
patches.description: Stops the document viewer from aborting when opening any PDF. Nutrient's license grants form viewing and filling but not form editing, yet the native library applies its editing-only license assertion to view-path calls such as form field loading, so the process is killed.

options.description: Blanks the native 'For Evaluation Purposes Only' watermark. A cloned package's bundle identifier does not match the bundled Nutrient license, so the SDK stamps the watermark over every document.

patches.name: Remove Tracking and Analytics
patches.description: Neutralizes behavioral tracking (Pendo SDK session recordings, guides, and click tracking), student surveillance telemetry (Pandata pageview recording, time-spent counters, and background upload worker), first-party app analytics (ScreenView processors, offline analytics, token logging), crash reporting (Firebase Crashlytics), and in-app rating prompts.

options.description: Sets the Firebase Crashlytics collection manifest flag to false and removes the Crashlytics NDK registrar. The existing Java Crashlytics method stubs remain active.

patches.name: Show Remote Config Editor
patches.description: Adds the hidden Remote Config editor to Settings, allowing Firebase remote-config overrides and experimental flags to be inspected and changed.

patches.name: Unlock Notebook and Offline Content
patches.description: Forces the client-side Notebook and Offline Content environment feature flags on, regardless of the institution's rollout. Server support is still required for content sync.

options.description: Forces FeatureFlagProvider.notebookEnabled to return true.
Forces FeatureFlagProvider.offlineEnabled to return true.

patches.name: Enable Notifications and Live Activities
patches.description: Enables Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) push notifications and Live Activities (live game score lockscreen and notification drawer updates) by spoofing the release certificate SHA-1, bypassing Play Services signature checks for MicroG, and activating the live score tracker gate.

options.description: Spoofs the release signing certificate SHA-1 in Firebase Installations requests so FCM registration succeeds on re-signed APKs.
Bypasses GoogleSignatureVerifier checks to allow push registration with MicroG and unverified Play Services.
Forces the Live Activity game score tracker toggle to be available on all live and upcoming games.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes Google Ad Manager banner and native advertisements, disables Blaze story/moment sponsored placements, blocks Google Interactive Media Ads (IMA) video ad requests, and neutralizes Brightcove IMA mid-roll and pre-roll ad playback.

options.description: Removes the promotions carousel from the Home screen.

patches.name: Remove Tracking
patches.description: Removes the OneTrust CMP tracking consent popup, zeros Google Play Advertising ID (AAID), blocks host application analytics, disables Firebase Analytics, AppMeasurement, Firebase Performance Monitoring, Crashlytics, and Sessions telemetry, neutralizes UrbanAirship and Blaze tracking, user activity, and logging, suppresses Brightcove video metrics reporting and backlog processing, and blocks Ticketmaster telemetry.

options.description: Neutralizes OneTrust CMP tracking consent popups, network calls, and routes consent checks so push notification SDKs remain consented while advertising and tracking remain denied.
Removes the broken Privacy Settings entry from the Settings screen.
Spoofs the Google Play Advertising ID (AAID) to return an all-zero identifier and limit ad tracking.
Blocks host application screen tracking and interaction event logging.
Blocks Firebase Analytics, AppMeasurement, and the WebView JavaScript analytics bridge.
Neutralizes Firebase Performance Monitoring traces, metrics, and gauge collection.
Neutralizes UrbanAirship install referrer capture, event queueing, session tracking, and metered usage telemetry.
Blocks Blaze SDK bulk event analytics, user viewing activity history, and remote diagnostic logging.
Suppresses Brightcove video playback metrics, interactivity tracking, and backlog processing.
Neutralizes Ticketmaster authentication analytics, event reporting queues, and presence analytics.
Neutralizes Firebase Crashlytics logging, exception capture, Sessions lifecycle monitoring, and DataTransport uploads.

patches.name: Unlock Hidden Features
patches.description: Unlocks the internal Developer Settings menu, Draft Mini Tracker, and NHL GameZone on the Home surface, with independent options for each feature.

options.description: Unlocks the internal Developer Settings screen inside Settings (Environment switcher, Analytics Debugger, String Key Overlay, Mock Localization, Invalidate Cache, and Ad Inspector), and activates the nhl://setAPI deep link.
Forces the shipped Draft Mini Tracker visibility gate on; tracker content still depends on NHL draft data.
Forces the shipped NHL GameZone Home visibility gate on; web content and authentication remain server-controlled.

patches.name: Web Ad Blocker
patches.description: Blocks advertisements, sponsored banners, and analytics tracking in NHL article views and embedded web content using bundled NHL rules and optional downloadable filter list subscriptions (EasyList, EasyPrivacy).

patches.name: Clean Authentication
patches.description: Removes the unavailable phone sign-in controls while keeping Google and Apple sign-in.

options.description: Adds a patched-app caution warning below the Google sign-in message on the login screen.

patches.name: Clean Home
patches.description: Removes store/brand carousels and promotional banners from the Home tab, with an optional shortcut-row cleanup.

options.description: Hides the Your Shortcuts row and its quick-action pills. Disabled by default so the Home tab keeps its shortcuts.
Removes the store header, category store lists, and brand carousels.
Removes the Home deal, cashback, and subscription promotional banners.
Hides the floating Sezzle Spend balance notification. It represents real spendable balance, so this is opt-in.

patches.name: Configure Shortcuts
patches.description: Customizes items displayed in the Your Shortcuts carousel.

options.description: Hides the Refer a Friend shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Giveaway shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Offers shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Rewards shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Sezzle Mobile shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Amazon Deals shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Pay Later Anywhere shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Sezzle Points shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Sezzle Spend shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.
Hides the Sezzle Up shortcut from the Your Shortcuts carousel.

patches.name: Enable App Debugging
patches.description: Marks the app debuggable so patch developers can use ADB run-as after reinstalling.

patches.name: Hide Sezzle Mobile
patches.description: Hides Sezzle Mobile offers and account entry points.

patches.name: Patch Consent Screen
patches.description: Requires consent to a patched-app warning before opening Sezzle authentication.

patches.name: Remove Ads and Tracking
patches.description: Removes all ads (AppLovin MAX, Google Mobile Ads, Rokt, Thanks network, Playtime, InBrain Surveys) and disables analytics and tracking SDKs (AppsFlyer, FullStory, Braze, Firebase Analytics, mParticle, Facebook SDK, AppCenter).

patches.name: Remove Promos & Giveaways
patches.description: Blocks in-app deal popups, giveaway screens, Knot card-linking dialogs, and marketing banners across the app.

options.description: Suppresses in-session merchant deal popovers, store offer modals, and webview deal overlays.
Suppresses Knot card auto-sync onboarding dialogs, activation gates, and account linking banners.
Removes promotional merchant cards, empty state marketing, and boost banners from wallet screens.
Neutralizes Playtime campaign listings and rewards promo carousels in Hermes UI.
Hides referral invite banners ("Give and Get"), contact permission prompts, and social share modals.
Hides live trivia giveaway banners and push-to-start game prompts.
Suppresses the pre-permission "Don't Miss Out!" marketing dialog (NotificationPermissionModalV2 / EnableNotificationsModal) and bypasses soft push-opt-in gates.

patches.name: Remove Rewards
patches.description: Removes the Rewards bottom navigation tab while keeping Account's Sezzle Points item accessible.

patches.name: Remove Sezzle Subscriptions
patches.description: Removes references to Sezzle Anywhere and Sezzle Premium subscriptions in Account benefits, the Home gift card carousel, Wallet, and Orders help.

options.description: Hides the Home Most Popular Gift Cards carousel. Gift cards require an active Sezzle Anywhere subscription.

patches.name: Rename Shop to Home
patches.description: Renames the Shop bottom navigation tab to Home.

patches.name: Replace AI Discover with Products
patches.description: Replaces the AI Discover navigation tab with Sezzle's original non-AI Products tab and removes the Sezzle AI callout in search. Includes an option to remove the Products tab completely.

options.description: Removes the Products tab from the navigation bar altogether instead of keeping it as a replacement for Discover.

patches.name: Suppress In-App Updates and Rating Prompts
patches.description: Neutralizes Hermes Redux update sagas, UpdateAppModal dialogs, Play Store URL redirects, trustFall tamper detection, and in-app rating prompts.

options.description: Neutralizes Redux force update sagas, version verification selectors, and UpdateAppModal.
Forces trustFall, isJailBroken, hookDetected, and canMockLocation to always return false in Hermes JS.
Suppresses in-app review requests and milestone rating dialogs that redirect to Google Play.

patches.name: Unlock Custom App Icons
patches.description: Enables custom launcher app icons (Arctic, Peach, Glass, Rainbow, Sand, Classic) without requiring a Sezzle Premium subscription.

patches.name: Unlock Developer Settings
patches.description: Makes the internal Development Settings menu visible to every signed-in account.

patches.name: Unlock Receipt Scanner
patches.description: Makes the receipt scanner available from Development Settings and forces its V2 flow to render. REQUIRES Unlock Developer Settings to be enabled.

patches.name: AMOLED Theme
patches.description: Applies a pure-black AMOLED palette to SidelineSwap's Compose theme: black surfaces and container tokens, readable light text and icons, a black launch window, light system-bar icons, and force-dark embedded WebViews.

patches.name: Block Tracking and Telemetry
patches.description: Neutralizes first-party analytics (SidelineSwap backend), behavioral tracking (Amplitude, Firebase Analytics, Iterable), diagnostic telemetry (Firebase Crashlytics), payment gateway telemetry (Braintree FPTI), Google Play Install Referrer, and zeros the Google Play Advertising ID (AAID).

options.description: Neutralizes SidelineSwap's first-party HTTP event client. The fan-out multiplexer stays intact so the remaining clients stay independently controllable.
Neutralizes the Amplitude client wrapper's event, identification, and reset entry points.
Neutralizes the Google Play Services measurement event entry point and removes background AppMeasurement services and sessions.
Neutralizes the Crashlytics user-id wrapper and stops the crash handler from recording exceptions, while the default handler still terminates crashed processes.
Neutralizes the Iterable client wrapper and SDK identity/FCM registration entry points, and removes Iterable push services and receivers.
Stubs Braintree FPTI background upload and database workers with immediate success.
Spoofs the Google Play AdvertisingIdClient entry points to return an all-zero UUID and forces limit-ad-tracking to true.
Neutralizes the Google Play Services install-referrer reporter.

patches.name: Change Brand Color
patches.description: Customizes the primary brand accent color across SidelineSwap buttons, navigation highlights, badges, and accents.

options.description: Hex color string (e.g. #1E88E5 for Material Blue, #9C27B0 for Purple, #FF5722 for Orange, #000000 for Monochrome).
Hex color string for the secondary accent and dark accents (defaults to #1565C0).

patches.name: Remove Invite Friends
patches.description: Removes the Invite Friends entry from the Account screen and blocks direct and deep-link navigation to the referral screen.

patches.name: Add Custom Chip Store
patches.description: Replaces the unavailable store with a dialog to view and set your exact chip balance.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes banner, interstitial, and rewarded advertising and removes ad-based chip offers.

patches.name: Remove Internet Permissions
patches.description: Removes Internet permissions from AndroidManifest.xml to prevent network access.

options.description: Removes Help Center buttons whose network-only content is unavailable without Internet access.

patches.name: Remove Notifications
patches.description: Removes notification permissions from AndroidManifest.xml to eliminate push notifications entirely.

patches.name: Remove Tracking and Analytics
patches.description: Neutralizes active advertising telemetry, analytics, attribution, and crash reporting.

patches.name: Skip to Next Level
patches.description: Allows tapping the next level indicator on the top bar to show a confirmation dialog and skip to the next level. REQUIRES Add Custom Chip Store to be enabled.
